info.title: Mahi Repair Firebase Cloud Run API
info.description: Normative machine-readable contract for the Mahi Repair Android and canonical Admin web clients. Firebase ID tokens are verified on every protected route; Owner/Member roles are loaded from server-managed profiles. See docs/CLOUD_RUN_API_CONTRACT.md for the full security and migration contract.

servers.description: Replace with the deployed Cloud Run service URL

bearerAuth.description: Firebase Auth ID token; Cloud Run verifies issuer, audience, signature, expiry and revocation.
